mainEntity.name: Can an in-law addition include a full kitchen in the Tampa Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether an in-law suite can feature a complete kitchen depends on local zoning codes, lot designations, and building safety regulations across municipalities like Brandon, Tampa, or unincorporated Hillsborough County. Many jurisdictions distinguish between an attached guest suite and a fully independent accessory dwelling unit. Full kitchens with 220-volt stove outlets or gas ranges may classify the structure as a multi-family dwelling, which is restricted in certain single-family zones. In contrast, wet bars or kitchenettes with a sink, compact refrigerator, and countertop microwave are widely permitted. Your contractor can check municipal codes during the design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Full kitchens depend on local municipal zoning classifications for single-family properties; kitchenettes or wet bars are often approved where full stoves are restricted.
